records.quotation: In the forward reaction, the σ-withdrawing character of the fluorine atoms would activate the alkene for nucleophilic attack by the thiol.5,6,9–11 However, in practice, nucleophilic addition of a thiolate into gem-difluoroalkenes generates an anionic intermediate 2 that can readily undergo β-fluoride elimination.6,10 This elimination has been partially overcome using several different strategies (Figure 1B),5 such as kinetically quenching the anionic intermediate 2 with molecular oxygen,12 exploiting an acidic organocatalyst,8,13 or trapping the anion with an appended electrophile.14 However, these strategies only function on styrenyl gem-difluoroalkenes, which react through stabilized benzylic carbanion intermediates.

records.claim: Aniline additive increases formation of the difluorinated thioether, while K2CO3 favors the undesired monofluorovinyl thioether and lowers chemoselectivity.
records.quotation:
Control experiments indicate that the aniline additives facilitate formation of the α,α−difluorinated thioether product (21, Figure 4A; S6), which contrasts previously reported conditions for defluorinative thiolation that utilized K2CO3 as an additive (Figure 2C).22 As a control, the reaction of gem-difluorostyrene 1 with octane-1-thiol proceeds in 45% yield and 19:1 selectivity in the absence of an additive (entry 1), while the addition of 10% p-aminoacetophenone increases the yield to 68% and selectivity beyond 25:1 (entry 2).
In contrast, addition of K2CO3 (2.0 equiv.) increases the yield of undesired Sorrentino et al.
α-fluorovinylthioether 25 and decreases the selectivity of the reaction to 2:1 (entry 3), while the addition of both p-aminoacetophenone and K2CO3 provides yield and selectivity comparable to the control reaction that lacks both additives (entry 4 vs.
1).

records.claim: The authors speculate that the aniline additive may mediate redox events or act as a PCET co-catalyst and hydrogen-atom donor, but explicitly state that robust mechanistic support is absent.
records.quotation:
At this point, we speculate that the aniline additive might mediate the redox events between the Ir-based catalyst and the thiol substrate, and also serve a role as an H• donor to quench radical intermediates (Figure 2B).25,26 A range of aliphatic gem-difluoroalkenes successfully coupled with 3-mercaptophenol (26) to afford α,α-difluoroalkylthioethers in good to excellent yields (Figure 5).
Further, this reaction exploits an underutilized aniline- derived additive as a possible redox mediator and/or PCET co-catalyst, enhancing fluorine retentive hydrofunctionalization of gem-difluoroalkenes.
The reported reaction contrasts related conditions that utilize K2CO3 that undergo a SET to generate anion 18 prior to β-fluoride elimination (Figure 2C).22 However, robust support for aniline’s role does not exist in the literature.
Mechanistic studies of this iridium and aniline co-catalyzed reaction are underway and will be reported separately in due course.

card.title: Access to a fluorinated acceptor gates nucleophile transfer
card.relationship: For an alkyl–CF3 substrate with an adjacent eliminable C–H bond, dehydrofluorination can expose a gem-difluoroalkene that accepts nucleophiles and undergoes a second fluoride loss. Increasing access to that acceptor opens a bond-forming route that a stronger nucleophile alone cannot supply. A chelation-assisted metal route is a separate activation option, not evidence that every substrate passes through the same alkene.

directional_implications.change: Enable the initial HF-elimination/acceptor-forming step while retaining donor compatibility
directional_implications.chemical_effect: Make an electrophilic fluorinated carbon accessible for addition
directional_implications.consequence: A partner supported on gem-difluoroalkenes becomes a justified conditional candidate for a saturated CF3 precursor.

directional_implications.change: Change from amide to ketone, remove directing functionality, or change metal activation
directional_implications.chemical_effect: Alter the accessibility and competing reactions of the acceptor
directional_implications.consequence: Reopen activation and carbonyl-attack questions; do not inherit success from the donor class.

source_scope: Adam/Fronczek/Colby: morpholine 3,3,3-trifluoropropanamide plus Grignard reagent; difluoroacrylamide observed by 19F NMR; subsequent enolate not observed.
Coradi/Bandar: unactivated (trifluoromethyl)alkanes under strong-base conditions; O/S and selected N/P additions lead to fluorovinyl intermediates; final acid step targets CF2 products.
Du2022/Shen2021 author abstracts establish separate N-chelation-assisted N/S precedents on trifluoropropanamides; they do not establish shared alkene intermediates.
card.mechanism_status: Intermediate observation in the specific Grignard system; source-proposed sequence in the acid/base system; conditional transfer to current ketone/amide and new donors.
candidate_generation_rules: Expand beyond seed organoboron partners to direct anions, neutral donors activated in situ, and latent donors only with an explicit compatible activation hypothesis.
Keep ketone and amide electrophiles separate, and flag donor-induced carbonyl addition or substrate reduction.
Retain radical and ambident candidates as alternative routes rather than forcing them into one polar pathway.

representative_candidates.logic: Direct carbon donor probes anionic capture but strong basicity/carbonyl attack may change the substrate skeleton.

representative_candidates.name: methanol
representative_candidates.logic: An O donor needs both acceptor access and compatible alkoxide generation.

representative_candidates.name: thiophenol
representative_candidates.logic: An S–H entry is chemically different from a preactivated disulfide despite potentially related sulfur capture.

exceptions: No claim that base strength monotonically increases target formation.
No guarantee that the seed or all N/O/S cases use the observed Grignard pathway.
Chelation, direct C–F activation, carbonyl trapping and rearrangement remain alternatives.

card.title: Accessible donor speciation and capture competence must coincide
card.relationship: Deprotonation or unmasking can raise the population of a bond-forming donor, but resonance stabilization, steric shielding, ion pairing and competing reactive atoms can lower or redirect its capture. Thus, a more basic neutral donor need not be more effective in a deprotonation-dependent reaction, and changing a precursor can change performance without changing the transferred element.

directional_implications.change: Use a donor that can form the required anion under the available base/medium
directional_implications.consequence: Can enable capture when the neutral donor does not react.

directional_implications.change: Increase resonance delocalization or steric shielding at the reactive atom
directional_implications.chemical_effect: May improve acidity while decreasing intrinsic capture or shifting the favored site
directional_implications.consequence: Choose contrasting electronic/steric variants, not a single pKa or elemental ranking.

directional_implications.change: Switch neutral donor to salt, organometallic or silylated precursor
directional_implications.chemical_effect: Change active-species generation, counterion and competing chemistry
directional_implications.consequence: Treat precursor forms as distinct candidates with distinct activation conditions.

source_scope: Coradi/Bandar: N-methylaniline gives fluoroenamine whereas piperidine fails under the examined base-promoted conditions; acidity rationale is proposed, not experimentally isolated.
Paleta et al.: branched alkoxides react more slowly than primary alkoxides on difluorobutenolides; organolithium and Cu-modified Grignard donors give different sites/pathways.
Thornbury/Toste: boronic-acid/boron-salt transfer differs from sluggish boronic esters and inert arylstannanes/arylsilanes in one Pd system.
Jiang et al. author abstract: Cs2CO3 with TMSCN/TMSCF3 maintains nucleophilic anions.
card.mechanism_status: Source-specific observations support precursor-, steric- and site-dependence; cross-class coupling of speciation and capture is a qualitative synthesis, not a measured universal rate law.
candidate_generation_rules: Enumerate neutral/salt/latent-precursor pairs: methanol/alkoxide, phenol/phenoxide, aniline/anilide, thiol/thiolate, and silylated carbon donors.
Span localized, aryl-delocalized, aromatic and carbonyl/sulfonyl-delocalized N donors; retain uncertain amides and sulfonamides with explicit activation questions.
Vary aryl electronics and steric bulk; retain ambident C/O and C/N alternatives with atom-specific targets.

representative_candidates.name: aniline / lithium anilide
representative_candidates.logic: Neutral/anion pair separates donor availability from structural identity.

representative_candidates.name: methanol / sodium methoxide / lithium methoxide
representative_candidates.logic: Precursor and counterion variation, without assuming the salts are universally superior.

representative_candidates.name: sodium dimethyl malonate / silyl ketene acetal
representative_candidates.logic: Different C-nucleophile formulations probe anion access and activation compatibility.

representative_candidates.name: lithium acetone enolate / pyrrole
representative_candidates.logic: Preserve C/O or C/N capture alternatives instead of a forced elemental label.

exceptions: Acidity alone does not isolate the aniline/piperidine contrast.
Branched O-donor effects on cyclic difluorobutenolides do not establish a universal steric penalty: tertiary thiols work in a distinct photochemical hydrothiolation.
TMSCN/TMSCF3 evidence does not validate TMSN3, all silyl enol ethers, or all silylated donors.
historical_relation: Seven original partner lenses and precursor-state expansion prompts
card.reconstruction_status: Cross-class relationship newly organized; individual candidate reactive forms, reasons and citations are preserved verbatim from original records

card.title: The state formed by capture controls fluoride loss versus fluorine retention
card.relationship: Where capture generates a suitably configured anionic or metal-associated β-fluoro intermediate, β-fluoride elimination can produce a monofluoroalkene. In compatible radical-addition systems, hydrogen-atom termination can instead trap a saturated CF2 product. Conditions that increase anionic elimination relative to H-termination can therefore improve the monofluoro branch even when they lower the yield of a competing hydroaddition product.

directional_implications.change: Favor anionic/metal-associated addition with accessible β-F geometry
directional_implications.chemical_effect: Enable fluoride expulsion before protonation or other termination
directional_implications.consequence: Favor a fluorinated alkene over a fluorine-retaining saturated adduct, only in systems with that intermediate.

directional_implications.change: Favor radical capture followed by efficient H-atom donation
directional_implications.chemical_effect: Quench the radical without fluoride loss
directional_implications.consequence: Can improve C–heteroatom capture while diverting from the monofluoroalkene target.

source_scope: Carbon: Grignard trapping after observed difluoroacrylamide formation; enolate/F-elimination sequence partly inferred.
Oxygen: difluorobutenolide oxyanion substitution is interpreted as addition then fluoride expulsion.
Sulfur: Sorrentino et al. directly change additive effects; K2CO3 increases fluorovinylthioether relative to CF2 hydrothiolation, whereas an aniline additive favors CF2 product.
Phosphorus provides an additional source-specific contrast between polar phosphinylation and peroxide-initiated hydrophosphinylation, not the organizing axis.
card.mechanism_status: Product branching is experimentally observed in individual sources. Aniline HAT/PCET role and several local intermediates are source hypotheses; no universal mechanism is asserted.
candidate_generation_rules: Retain both deprotonatable donors and radical precursors as differentiated hypotheses with explicit fluorine-count endpoints.
For each donor require a target C–Nu connection and distinguish monofluoroalkene, CF2 addition product, full defluorination and carbonyl addition.
Do not classify a radical donor as impossible: reduction to an anion can restore elimination in a different catalytic setting, which must be separately supported.

representative_candidates.name: thiophenol / sodium thiophenolate
representative_candidates.logic: Same S fragment can enter radical or polar chemistry; terminal fluorine count is part of the route hypothesis.

representative_candidates.name: methanol
representative_candidates.logic: O-capture on a verified fluorinated acceptor can lead to an addition–elimination product; proton competition remains condition-dependent.

representative_candidates.name: NHPI acetate
representative_candidates.logic: A retained radical-precursor boundary candidate, not a predicted successful monofluoroalkene donor.

exceptions: Nitro-substituted gem-difluoroalkenes undergo fluoride elimination even in peroxide conditions in the P(O)H source.
Not every radical route retains CF2 and not every polar addition eliminates F.
Capture on a gem-difluoroalkene establishes only a local step, not two-F loss from the saturated project substrate.
card.reconstruction_status: Expanded from historical local β-F-elimination constraint; source-specific cross-class examples added for explanation

card.title: Selective formation must outpace downstream consumption
card.relationship: When the first fluorinated product remains reactive, greater reagent exposure or stronger downstream activation can consume it by further coupling, hydrofluorination or additional C–F loss. Product accumulation therefore depends on a window that permits initial capture while suppressing subsequent transformation. This relation applies only when the downstream reaction is accessible; source-proven persistence is an explicit exception.

directional_implications.change: Increase excess donor/reductant or activate a documented downstream product reaction
directional_implications.chemical_effect: Increase secondary product consumption relative to formation
directional_implications.consequence: Lower accumulation of the intended fluorination state even if starting-material conversion improves.

directional_implications.change: Reduce the reagent exposure that causes verified secondary reaction
directional_implications.consequence: Can recover selective accumulation without changing the initial donor class.

directional_implications.change: Change electron donation of the newly attached heteroatom group
directional_implications.chemical_effect: Change susceptibility of a fluorovinyl product to protonation and subsequent addition
directional_implications.consequence: Product survival must be evaluated separately for N-, O- and S-linked targets.

source_scope: Thornbury/Toste: one susceptible monofluorostilbene gives overcoupled products; near-stoichiometric boronic acid remedies that case.
Zhang/Yang/Cheng: hydrosilane stoichiometry controls mono/di-HDF; further PhSiH3 can remove the third fluoride from some electron-poor substrates.
Coradi/Bandar: O-vinyl products undergo intentional acid-dependent hydrofluorination; N/P intermediates form but fail the subsequent source CF2 endpoint.
Sorrentino: isolated CF2 thioether is stable to K2CO3 under the tested conditions, excluding that product as the elimination intermediate.
card.mechanism_status: Observed secondary reactions and resubjection tests in source systems; not evidence that all project monofluoroalkenes are kinetic intermediates or that stronger base universally over-defluorinates.
candidate_generation_rules: Retain electronic and donor-form diversity to probe both formation and persistence; do not rank all candidates by initial nucleophilicity alone.
Record alternative endpoints and recovery risks with every proposed molecule.
Treat coordinating donors and scavenger effects as system-specific compatibility tests; source inhibition can justify an individual negative control but not an element-wide exclusion.

representative_candidates.name: 4-pyridylboronic acid / 2,6-dimethylphenylboronic acid
representative_candidates.logic: Electronics, steric effects and coordination can change formation and subsequent coupling; source-specific evaluation remains required.

representative_candidates.name: phenol / sodium phenoxide
representative_candidates.logic: O-donor formulation and fluorovinyl-product fate are separate questions.

representative_candidates.name: diphenylphosphine / benzeneselenol
representative_candidates.logic: Selected unfavorable cases can be negative trials; positive P/Se precedents and incomplete project condition records prohibit class-wide rejection.

exceptions: Stable fluorinated products need not be transient stopping points.
Failure of source hydrofluorination is not failure to form the monofluoro intermediate sought here.
Changes in salt, water or base may alter donor/catalyst speciation rather than product-consumption rates.
card.reconstruction_status: Replaces a generic stopping-point slogan with source-specific direction and an explicit persistence exception

nodes.name: Pyridin-4-ylboronic acid

summary.activation_hypothesis: Base-assisted boronate formation and compatible metal transfer are proposed.
summary.rationale: Tests electron-poor heteroaryl transfer and pyridine coordination; the archived structure is the 4-pyridyl isomer.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 以温和碱产生硼酸盐；应平行考察完整 Seed 条件和能降低游离吡啶配位影响的催化环境。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 加入等量吡啶作为外部抑制对照，并监测硼试剂存留和 Pd 失活；若游离吡啶抑制苯硼酸而本试剂又被快速消耗，可区分配位抑制与供体分解。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 吡啶-3-硼酸
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 吡啶-3-基硼酸盐或相应金属杂芳基物种；环氮不是拟成键原子。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 同时探测缺电子杂芳基和配位风险。拟成键位置是与硼相连的 3-吡啶基碳，不是吡啶氮。
risks: 吡啶氮可能配位并改变 Pd 物种
杂芳基硼酸可能快速原硼化
碱和水含量可改变试剂形态
低产率可能来自催化剂抑制而非 C-C 成键本身
historical_hypotheses.route: 通过转移 3-吡啶基保持目标烯碳连接方式，同时把配位能力作为独立变量。

nodes.label: C009
nodes.name: Benzylzinc bromide

summary.activation_hypothesis: Compatible metal transfer or single-electron activation can transfer the benzyl fragment.
summary.rationale: Tests a non-boron benzyl donor; direct carbonyl addition remains a competing pathway.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 通常以预形成有机锌溶液直接转金属化，或配合 Cu/Ni 等催化剂；需严格无水无氧，并避免默认 Pd168 适用。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 测定有机锌剩余量、甲苯、联苄、羰基加成醇和目标苄基化单氟烯烃；比较无催化剂、Cu/Ni 催化及低温条件以区分直接加成和催化转移。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 溴化苄基锌
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 苄基锌、转金属化后的苄基金属物种或单电子过程产生的苄基自由基；与 Zn 相连的苄基碳 atom 2 为拟成键原子。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 提供不含硼的金属转移入口，检验 Seed 的 C–C 成键是否可由较极性的苄基供体实现，同时把直接羰基加成作为明确竞争路径。
risks: 强烈水氧敏感，实际物种可能聚集或发生 Schlenk 型平衡
可能优先对羰基 1,2-加成
转金属化或单电子过程可能生成联苄、甲苯及过度脱氟产物
historical_hypotheses.route: 在匹配的无水体系中直接测试或经 Cu/Ni 转移 atom 2；不要求原有机硼伙伴或原 Pd 循环，目标仍为 CF3 衍生碳与苄基碳的固定连接。

historical_hypotheses.name: 甲基锂

historical_hypotheses.reason: 高碱性硬碳负离子的极端边界。所引文献观察到甲基锂可改走重排路径，因此这里是有意的机制压力测试，不是成功先例。

historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 与苯硼酸和单邻位取代类似物比较初速、硼试剂消耗及目标/完全脱氟比；若试剂持续存在而碳转移很慢，支持空间阻碍位于转金属化或成键步骤。

historical_hypotheses.name: 2,6-二甲基苯硼酸
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 2,6-二甲基苯基硼酸盐或相应金属芳基物种。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 明确的邻位双取代空间边界探针；成键原子仍为与硼相连的芳基碳。用于区分空间阻碍、硼试剂分解和产物不稳定性。
risks: 邻位位阻可能减慢转金属化或 C-C 成键
加热补偿可能增加完全脱氟
原硼化和硼氧烷形成
低转化不能单独证明芳基家族不适用
historical_hypotheses.route: 尝试把 2,6-二甲基苯基接到 CF3 衍生烯碳，以最大化与简单苯基之间的空间差异。

historical_hypotheses.activation: 需要无水条件下生成或使用预成的硝基甲烷钠盐；可通过改变阳离子和极性溶剂调节离子对及 C/O 反应。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 使用 13CH3NO2 来源的盐确认碳连接，并搜索硝酸酯型 O-连接物；与丙二酸酯盐比较可判别软硬性和碱性，而非只比较转化率。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 硝基甲烷钠盐
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 硝基甲烷的碳负离子/硝酸根式共振离子对；拟成键原子为碳。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 小型、强极化且双位反应的碳供体，用于覆盖非羰基稳定化阴离子。它可能通过直接 vinylic 取代或加成-失氟引入硝基甲基。
risks: C/O 双位反应

historical_hypotheses.route: 将硝基甲基碳接到 CF3 衍生烯碳，并以 C/O 连接分析作为主要判据。

historical_hypotheses.activation: 使用与O端提案完全相同且经确认的锂丙酮烯醇盐条件；这里只改变被检验的成键原子归属，不另行改变试剂或条件。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 通过末端烯醇碳的13C标记确认是否形成CF3来源碳-C(烯醇盐)键；与索引3的O端产物定量比较，从而避免把ambident反应误归为氧成键。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 锂丙酮烯醇盐，C端竞争提案
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 同一锂烯醇盐的碳端共振形式；索引0为本提案的成键碳，索引3为未成键的烯醇氧，索引4为锂。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 该提案不是把碳亲核体当作氧亲核体，而是为oxygen镜头保留并明确映射同一ambident试剂的竞争碳端结果。它能判别观察到的转化是否真正支持C-O键形成。
risks: C端产物会偏离期望的C-O键类型但仍占用目标电亲位点
后续互变异构可能掩盖初始成键原子
羰基1,2-加成可能产生相同分子量副产物
强碱和锂配位可能改变脱氟计数
historical_hypotheses.route: 与O端提案共享同一分步试验；仅将索引0与CF3来源烯碳形成的新C-C键计为该竞争假设的阳性结果。

historical_hypotheses.activation: 以预制并经谱学或滴定确认的锂丙酮烯醇盐测试；低温生成与升温反应应分开，避免把原位成盐副反应误作目标捕获。

citations.quote: The mechanism can be formulated (Scheme 1) as a 1,4-addition followed by the expulsion of ﬂuoride ion from the intermediate metal enolate 3, which appeared to be unable to abstract proton from the super- ﬂuous methanol present in the mixture.

historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 本提案专门寻找O端成键的C(F)-O-C(=C)CH3或其互变异构产物；与同一SMILES的碳端提案平行，通过13C标记末端烯醇碳及二维NMR定量O/C成键比。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 锂丙酮烯醇盐，O端成键提案
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 形式烯醇氧负离子；索引3为本提案的成键氧，索引0为竞争的亲核碳，索引4为锂。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 直接覆盖氧/碳双位亲核体，并把O端连接作为独立假设。引证只提出另一体系中的金属烯醇盐与氟离子排出，不能证明该烯醇盐会在目标中心O-烯醇化。
risks: C端烷基化可能压倒O端成键
可对Seed羰基发生1,2-加成或引发烯醇交换
强碱性可能促进完全脱氟
O端初生产物可能快速发生Claisen型重排或水解
historical_hypotheses.route: 使用可信偕二氟烯酮进行无Pd直接捕获，并与碳端映射实验成对分析；目标位点仍为原CF3来源烯碳。

nodes.label: C004
nodes.name: 2-Methylfuran

summary.activation_hypothesis: Electrophile activation can enable attack at the unblocked alpha carbon.
summary.rationale: Pairs electron donation with blocking of one furan alpha position; regioselectivity and acid sensitivity require testing.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 采用可控Lewis酸或Brønsted酸活化，并与未取代呋喃匹配比较；甲基封闭一个α位后不需要额外生成阴离子。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 确认新键位于未被甲基占据的另一α-碳；与呋喃比较区域异构体数量、初始速率和聚合损失，可检验位点封闭效应。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 2-甲基呋喃
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 中性芳香π亲核体；指定未取代的另一个α-碳成键，氧和甲基均不是成键中心。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 甲基提高电子密度并封闭一个α位，可能改善分析上的区域选择性；同时增加位阻，是电子促进与局部拥挤的成对探针。
risks: 仍可能酸促聚合或开环
甲基可能促进竞争质子化或烯丙位副反应
空间拥挤可能减慢目标进攻
产物可能发生第二次亲电取代
historical_hypotheses.route: 未占据的呋喃α-碳进攻CF3衍生烯基亲电体，芳构化后受控脱氟形成C(F)-杂芳基连接。

historical_hypotheses.activation: 需要把 Seed 片段转化为足够亲电的 gem-二氟烯酮、金属配位烯烃或自由基受体；2-甲基呋喃本身不预先去质子化。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 确认连接发生在呋喃 5 位，并比较暗反应、Lewis 酸及光催化条件；检测呋喃低聚、氧化和其他区域异构体，以区分真正的 π 加成与非选择性消耗。
historical_hypotheses.family: 富电子杂芳烃 π 核试剂
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 2-甲基呋喃
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 中性 2-甲基呋喃 π 系统；拟成键原子为未取代的 5 位碳，环氧不是成键中心。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 覆盖无需预成碳负离子或转金属化的中性 π 核试剂。它是 Friedel-Crafts 型或自由基极性交叉加成的边界假设。
risks: 可能需要过强活化而导致 Seed 羰基分解
呋喃易聚合、氧化或发生多位点反应
目标单氟烯烃可能继续接受亲核加成
低转化不能排除其他富电子 π 核试剂
historical_hypotheses.route: 尝试由呋喃 5 位直接在 CF3 衍生烯碳形成 C-C 键，随后通过失氟恢复共轭烯烃。

nodes.label: C005
nodes.name: Benzo[b]thiophene

summary.activation_hypothesis: Electrophile activation is proposed for carbon attack at the thiophene ring.
summary.rationale: Tests fused sulfur heteroaromatic carbon transfer; sulfur coordination is a competing role.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_citations.quote: Biphenyl (2i) and thiophene (2j) moieties were compatible.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 先以中性苯并噻吩测试 C2 的直接杂芳亲核加成；可考察温和 Lewis 酸或其他能够提高氟代烯亲电性的活化方式，但不要求预制硫负离子或有机金属试剂。

citations.quote: Biphenyl (2i) and thiophene (2j) moieties were compatible.

historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 用定量 19F NMR 和 GC/LC-HRMS 建立氟质量平衡，再以 HMBC 区分 C2、C3 与硫连接产物；加入噻吩或萘作为匹配对照，可判别稠合硫杂环的电子和配位效应。
historical_hypotheses.family: 稠合双环含硫芳香族；苯并噻吩型碳亲核体
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 苯并噻吩
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 中性苯并噻吩，提交噻吩环 C2（atom 5）为成键位点；环内硫可竞争配位，但不是本提案的成键中心。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 覆盖稠合含硫芳香骨架及 C2 碳成键，并可与吲哚比较 N/S 杂原子对直接芳香加成的影响。引文只说明另一 Rh/硼酸体系中噻吩基团可兼容，不是苯并噻吩直接亲核反应或 Seed 条件成功的证据。
risks: 硫可能与软金属中心结合并抑制或改写催化状态
C2/C3 区域选择性可能混合
Lewis 酸可能优先结合羰基或硫
目标单氟烯烃可能进一步脱氟、异构化或聚合
historical_hypotheses.route: 由苯并噻吩 C2 连接带保留 F 的 CF3 衍生烯碳，形成 C-C 键并在保持羰基骨架的同时净损失两个 F。

nodes.label: C015
nodes.name: 2,3-Dihydrofuran

summary.activation_hypothesis: Electrophile activation can enable carbon attack by the enol-ether pi system.
summary.rationale: Tests a cyclic neutral carbon donor; acid-mediated decomposition and alternative addition sites compete.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 需要温和电亲化条件；可把环状烯醚与乙基乙烯醚成对测试，以比较构象约束是否有利于后续消除。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 用二维NMR确定外来键位于烯醚β-碳，并检查四氢呋喃酮、开环羟基醛及聚合物；产物再暴露实验用于识别二次脱氟。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 2,3-二氢呋喃
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 中性环状烯醚；指定不直接连接氧的烯碳形成新键。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 环状烯醚限制了烯烃几何和进攻后构象，可检验是否需要特定的加成-脱氟排列，同时保持分子简单。
risks: 酸促开环或聚合
形成稳定缩醛型加合物而不发生目标消除
环张力和构象可能改变区域选择性
氧配位可能抑制金属活化
historical_hypotheses.route: β-烯碳对含氟烯基亲电中心加成，随后由环氧鎓样中间体发生质子/氟离子转移和消除，力求保留一个烯基F。

nodes.label: C017
nodes.name: 1,3,5-Trimethoxybenzene

summary.activation_hypothesis: Electrophile activation can enable aromatic carbon capture.
summary.rationale: Tests a strongly activated arene without a preformed carbon anion, with positional symmetry simplifying site assignment.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 优先采用低温、低酸度或可滴定Lewis酸活化；另设无金属和Seed Pd条件，以检验是否存在不依赖原有催化循环的直接芳基化。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 检查单芳基化、双芳基化与芳环质子损失；用对称性简化的NMR和HRMS确认只引入一个芳基，并做产物再暴露试验判断第二次脱氟是否为顺序过程。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 1,3,5-三甲氧基苯
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 中性、高电子密度芳香π亲核体；三个未取代芳环碳等价，提交原子3作为代表成键位点。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 作为高亲核性端点，它可检验中性芳环捕获是否主要受亲核性控制；对称结构也便于分析，但比二甲氧基苯更容易越过单取代停止点。
risks: 快速双取代可能消耗剩余烯基F
酸敏感甲氧基和富电子芳环可能发生分解或氧化
强吸附或配位可能改变催化剂状态
historical_hypotheses.route: 直接Friedel-Crafts型捕获含氟烯基亲电体，在目标烯碳形成芳基C-C键，随后控制脱氟数目使产物保留一个F。

nodes.name: Ethyl vinyl ether

summary.activation_hypothesis: Electrophile activation can enable attack through the terminal vinyl carbon.
summary.rationale: Tests neutral carbon pi nucleophilicity; O coordination, hydrolysis and polymerization can compete.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 可测试Lewis酸、电亲化金属或直接热加成窗口；水和质子源必须受控，以免烯醚先水解。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 用13C标记或HMBC确认末端烯碳与CF3衍生碳成键；监测乙醛/乙醇、水解物和低聚物，并比较有无捕获性碱来判断是否经历氧鎓离子。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 乙基乙烯醚
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 中性烯醚；指定远离氧的末端β-烯碳成键，氧只稳定进攻后形成的氧鎓/碳正离子特征中间体。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 它将搜索从芳香取代扩展到简单中性烯烃π供体，可通过直接亲电加成形成新C-C键，不要求有机硼转金属。
risks: 酸促水解或阳离子聚合
可能形成饱和加合物而不能消除至目标共轭烯烃
区域选择性可能反转
烯醚可能消耗Lewis酸
historical_hypotheses.route: 末端β-烯碳进攻活化的CF3衍生碳，形成氧鎓稳定的C-C加合物；随后通过氟离子/质子消除和双键重排达到目标单氟烯烃连接性。

nodes.name: Indole

summary.activation_hypothesis: The archived hypotheses specify carbon attack by the indole pi system.
summary.rationale: Tests C3-type capture while preserving N-H as a competing proton-transfer or bonding site.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_citations.quote:
Difluoroalkenes 5 coordinate with the cationic Pd(II) center to form π-complexes A, where the electron density of the difluoroalkene moiety is lowered.
The electrophilic activation of difluoroalkenes promotes Friedel–Crafts cyclization
2-Naphthyl (43), indole (44), pyridine (45) and 1,3-benzodioxole (46) were successfully incorporated into the final product.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 可从温和Lewis酸、π酸或电亲化Pd盐条件筛选，也应测试不含Pd的酸活化；避免一开始使用强碱，因为吲哚N-H可能改变反应形态。

citations.quote:
Difluoroalkenes 5 coordinate with the cationic Pd(II) center to form π-complexes A, where the electron density of the difluoroalkene moiety is lowered.
The electrophilic activation of difluoroalkenes promotes Friedel–Crafts cyclization

historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 通过2D NMR区分C3碳成键与N烯基化；加入N-甲基吲哚对照，并比较有无Pd和不同酸度，以判断C-进攻是否需要含氟烯烃电亲化。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 吲哚
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 中性杂芳香π亲核体；指定吲哚C3碳成键，环上N-H不是目标成键原子。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 吲哚C3是经典高电子密度碳位点，可覆盖杂芳环C-亲核性；N-H同时提供配位、去质子化和竞争N-成键风险，因而能判别位点选择性。
risks: 可能发生N-烯基化而不是C3成键
N-H可能结合碱或催化剂并改变底物活化
酸下可能低聚或多取代
产物可能继续脱氟
historical_hypotheses.route: 吲哚C3对活化的CF3衍生烯碳进攻，去质子化恢复芳香性，再经必要的脱氟形成目标C(F)-C3连接。

historical_hypotheses.activation: 先测试中性吲哚的直接 C3 亲核加成；按需要比较温和 Lewis 酸或 Brønsted 酸活化。应设无金属条件和催化条件对照，因为吲哚可与金属中心配位。

citations.quote: 2-Naphthyl (43), indole (44), pyridine (45) and 1,3-benzodioxole (46) were successfully incorporated into the final product.

historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 用 19F NMR 与 LC-HRMS 联合寻找 C3 加合和两次失氟产物；用吲哚 C2/C3 的 HMBC/NOE 关系确认区域选择性，同时检查 N-连接异构体。酸依赖而金属不依赖的 C3 产物将支持直接芳香亲核路径。
historical_hypotheses.family: 稠合双环含氮芳香族；吲哚型碳亲核体
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 吲哚
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 中性 1H-吲哚，提交 C3（atom 6）为成键中心；吡咯型 N-H 是竞争配位、去质子化或 N-成键位点。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 吲哚提供高亲核性的稠合 N-杂芳环，能检验 C3 芳香取代是否可绕开有机硼转移。引文仅说明吲哚支架在另一种氟代烯偶联中被纳入产物，当前固定羰基连接和净两次失氟均属外推。
risks: N-H 可能导致催化剂结合或酸碱副反应
C2/C3 或 N 位成键可能竞争
吲哚可能发生低聚、氧化或多次烷基化
较苛刻条件可能使目标单氟烯烃继续脱氟
historical_hypotheses.route: 由吲哚 C3 与带保留 F 的 CF3 衍生烯碳形成 C-C 键，同时保持羰基骨架并实现净损失两个 F。

nodes.name: Thiophene

summary.activation_hypothesis: Electrophile activation can enable alpha-carbon attack.
summary.rationale: Tests sulfur heteroaromatic carbon capture, with sulfur coordination distinguished from C-S bond formation.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 优先比较软Lewis酸/π酸与Seed Pd条件；硫可能强配位，因此需要催化剂预混和后加试剂两种次序作为机理控制。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 检测α-C取代、S-烯基化和未反应底物；通过催化剂预孵育抑制实验及加入非亲核硫醚对照，区分碳反应性与硫配位毒化。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 噻吩
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 中性芳香π亲核体；指定噻吩α-碳成键，硫不是目标成键原子。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 噻吩的碳π亲核性和硫配位性并存，可扩展软杂芳环空间并直接测试强配位风险是否掩盖潜在C-C成键。
risks: 硫可能抑制或重构Pd催化剂
区域异构和多取代
强活化条件下氧化或聚合
低转化不能单独归因于碳亲核性不足
historical_hypotheses.route: 噻吩α-碳捕获活化含氟烯碳并恢复芳香性，之后完成达到C(F)-噻吩连接所需的脱氟。

nodes.label: C029
nodes.name: N,N-Dimethylvinylamine

summary.activation_hypothesis: The neutral enamine can attack through the terminal carbon of its pi system.
summary.rationale: Tests an electron-rich carbon donor while retaining C/N ambident behaviour and hydrolysis as boundaries.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 可用温和Lewis酸或直接与预生成的含氟烯酮接触；必须避免强酸使烯胺完全质子化，也应比较无Pd条件。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 确认末端烯碳成键而非氮烷基化；测定质子化烯胺、胺盐和水解羰基副产物，并用相应烯醚作电子/杂原子对照。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: N,N-二甲基乙烯胺
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 中性烯胺；指定远离氮的末端β-烯碳成键，氮孤对电子仅提高π亲核性。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 烯胺代表强中性碳π亲核体，可在不依赖有机硼或预制碳负离子的情况下捕获电亲性含氟烯碳，并测试C/N两亲性。
risks: 优先N-成键或氮配位抑制催化剂
酸下质子化失去碳亲核性
易水解、氧化或聚合
加成物可能发生亚胺交换而破坏固定骨架
historical_hypotheses.route: 烯胺β-碳对CF3衍生亲电碳加成，继而经氟离子消除和烯胺水解或双键迁移形成目标C-C连接；必须确认碳骨架未裂解。

nodes.name: Styrene

summary.activation_hypothesis: Electrophile activation is proposed to enable terminal-carbon capture.
summary.rationale: Tests whether a simple aryl alkene has sufficient nucleophilicity; polymerization and alternative radical addition compete.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 需要足以电亲化含氟烯酮但不过度引发苯乙烯聚合的条件；适合从低温Lewis酸或短时阳离子金属活化开始，并设置自由基抑制剂对照但不据此预设自由基机理。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 确认新键位于苯乙烯末端碳并检查苄位区域异构体；SEC/GC用于评估聚合，自由基钟或抑制剂仅作为与离子加成区分的组合证据。
historical_hypotheses.family: 简单芳基烯烃边界探针
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 苯乙烯
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 中性碳碳双键π亲核体；指定末端烯碳成键，使正电荷或金属特征优先稳定在苄位碳。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 苯乙烯比烯醚和烯胺弱，但结构简单，可作为普通中性烯烃是否足以捕获活化含氟中心的边界探针。
risks: 酸或金属诱导聚合
可能发生Heck型、氢官能化或异构化而偏离固定连接性
可能形成饱和加成物而不消除
低转化可能来自底物未被充分电亲化
historical_hypotheses.route: 末端烯碳进攻CF3衍生亲电碳，形成苄位稳定中间体；随后质子和氟离子消除必须恢复原羰基共轭的单氟烯烃。

historical_hypotheses.route: C3对活化含氟烯碳进行Friedel-Crafts型进攻，随后芳构化和受控脱氟，建立目标C-C键。

nodes.name: Methyl acetate trimethylsilyl ketene acetal

summary.activation_hypothesis: Lewis-acid or silicon-directed activation can expose the terminal carbon nucleophile.
summary.rationale: Tests a neutral ester-enolate equivalent; hydrolysis, desilylation and direct carbonyl addition compete.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_citations.quote: The site of attack in enolate anions depends on the structure of the enolate as well as the nature of the electrophile, the solvent, and the counterion.[114]

historical_hypotheses.activation: 需要与硅烯醇醚相容的Lewis酸或亲氟活化剂；应设置无活化剂、仅Lewis酸和含氟底物三组稳定性对照。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 确认末端碳成键，并定量甲酯/羧酸衍生水解物、脱硅物及单氟/无氟烯烃；与苯乙酮硅烯醇醚比较可判别亲核性与产物稳定性。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 乙酸甲酯三甲基硅烯酮缩醛
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 中性硅基烯酮缩醛；指定末端烯碳成键，两个氧及硅均不作为目标成键中心。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 这是更富电子且带潜在酯功能的碳π供体，可扩展羰基稳定碳亲核体的电子范围，并检验氟亲和脱硅能否协助后续脱氟。
risks: 快速脱硅或水解导致失活
可能发生O-成键、酰基转移或多步缩合
生成的多羰基产物可能不稳定
氟硅反应会显著改变有效氟离子活度
historical_hypotheses.route: 末端烯碳进行Mukaiyama型C-C加成，随后脱硅及选择性消除，使新碳片段连接到保留F的原CF3衍生烯碳。

historical_hypotheses.activation: 通常需要 Lewis 酸或亲电金属物种活化电受体；应控制水和氟离子，因为它们可裂解硅烯醚。

citations.quote: The site of attack in enolate anions depends on the structure of the enolate as well as the nature of the electrophile, the solvent, and the counterion.[114]

historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 用标记的末端烯碳确认 C-C 键，并同时搜索 O-连接、简单水解及 Mukaiyama 醛醇产物；比较无 Lewis 酸和不同 Lewis 酸可判断真正电受体活化。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 1-甲氧基-1-(三甲基硅氧基)乙烯
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: Lewis 酸活化条件下的硅基烯酮缩醛；拟成键原子是末端烯碳，两个氧均不是目标成键中心。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 这是预组织的中性烯醇等价体，可降低强碱导致完全脱氟的风险，同时探测对假定 gem-二氟烯酮的 Mukaiyama 型共轭加成。
risks: 痕量水导致快速水解
可能优先发生羰基加成
Lewis 酸可能引起底物分解或 E/Z 异构化
硅对氟的亲和力可能促使非选择性多重失氟
historical_hypotheses.route: 使末端烯碳进攻 CF3 衍生烯碳，再利用 Si-F 形成帮助单次消除；是否能实现净两次失氟需实测。

nodes.label: C018
nodes.name: Allyltrimethylsilane

summary.activation_hypothesis: Electrophile activation and silicon-assisted allyl transfer are proposed.
summary.rationale: Tests a neutral allyl donor and silicon-fluoride formation, with allylic regiochemistry treated separately.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 可测试Lewis酸、电亲性Pd或预形成含氟烯酮；无需预金属化，但可能需要亲氟活化剂促进加成后的脱硅。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 通过HMBC和必要的同位素标记确认远离硅的烯丙基末端碳成键；检测烯丙基区域异构、脱硅质子化物和聚合物，以区别Sakurai型加成与普通烯烃加成。
historical_hypotheses.family: 烯丙基硅烷π/σ协同碳供体
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 烯丙基三甲基硅烷
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 中性烯丙基硅烷；指定远离硅的末端烯碳成键，C-Si σ键通过β-硅效应增强π进攻但硅不转移为目标连接。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 该试剂覆盖π键与C-Si σ键协同供电子的边界，可通过Sakurai型路径建立C-C键，不需要Seed的硼转金属步骤。
risks: 可能生成非共轭烯丙基加成物而无法达到固定目标烯烃
氟离子促脱硅可能导致质子化副产物
区域选择性和双键迁移复杂
强Lewis酸下可能低聚
historical_hypotheses.route: 远端烯碳对CF3衍生亲电碳进行Sakurai型加成，β-硅稳定中间体后脱硅；再经选择性脱氟/重排形成目标C(F)-烯丙基连接。

nodes.label: C024
nodes.name: Acetophenone trimethylsilyl enol ether

summary.activation_hypothesis: Lewis-acid or silicon-directed activation can enable terminal-carbon attack.
summary.rationale: Tests a neutral ketone-enolate equivalent; direct carbonyl addition and desilylation remain competing events.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 通常需要Lewis酸活化含氟烯酮并促进Mukaiyama型加成；水含量需严格分层测试，因为少量水既可能促水解也可能改变脱氟。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 用标记或HMBC确认末端烯醇碳成键；同步检测脱硅、苯乙酮再生、简单羟醛加成物和目标单氟烯烃，以判断是否完成加成后消除。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 苯乙酮三甲基硅烯醇醚
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 中性硅烯醇醚；指定末端烯醇碳成键，氧和硅不是目标成键原子。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 该试剂提供稳定、可操作的烯醇碳π亲核性，并能测试Mukaiyama型加成是否可与脱氟串联；它不要求Seed有机硼转金属步骤。
risks: 氟离子会快速脱硅并改变反应网络
可能只得到羰基加成物而不能形成目标烯烃
Lewis酸可能导致自缩合或底物分解
新生成的二羰基体系可能继续反应
historical_hypotheses.route: 末端烯醇碳对CF3衍生烯碳加成，氟离子捕获硅并促进脱硅；后续消除需恢复与原羰基共轭且保留一个F的烯烃。

nodes.label: C026
nodes.name: Trimethylsilyl cyanide

summary.activation_hypothesis: Silicon-directed or Lewis-acid activation can expose carbon-end cyanide transfer.
summary.rationale: Tests a compact carbon donor; cyanohydrin formation, catalyst binding and alternative connectivity compete.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 用 Lewis 酸或氟亲和试剂释放低稳态浓度的氰离子；也可在无金属条件下测试直接 vinylic 加成-消除。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 通过 13C 标记氰基碳和 IR/LC-MS 确认 C-CN 连接，并检查是否形成羰基氰醇；比较 TMSCN 与 KCN 可区分缓释、阳离子和硅捕氟效应。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 三甲基氰硅烷
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 活化后释放的氰碳亲核体或金属氰基物种；成键端为氰基碳，氮不是拟成键原子。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 最小的杂原子取代碳供体，能测试直接 vinylic 氰化是否可在目标碳发生并保留一个 F；不要求原始 Pd/硼循环。
risks: 优先对羰基形成氰醇并改变骨架
氰根可能强烈配位并抑制金属催化剂
TMSCN 和酸性活化剂具有显著操作危险
强 Si-F 驱动力可能导致超过目标次数的脱氟
historical_hypotheses.route: 缓释氰碳对含氟烯碳进行 C-C 成键，以氰醇形成作为关键竞争路径对照。

nodes.label: C037
nodes.name: Trimethylsilyl azide

summary.activation_hypothesis: Polar silicon-assisted transfer or a separately activated azidyl-radical branch is proposed.
summary.rationale: Tests terminal-N delivery; polar and radical pathways are alternatives, not an established shared mechanism.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 可由光氧化还原、氧化剂或金属催化生成叠氮自由基/叠氮转移物；也可测试 Lewis 酸促进的极性叠氮转移。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 通过 15N 标记的末端氮确认 atom 6 的连接位置，并检测 TMSF、叠氮自由基捕获物和 C(F)–N3 产物；自由基捕获剂和无光对照用于区分路径。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 三甲基硅基叠氮
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 末端氮参与成键的叠氮转移体或 N3•；远离硅的末端氮 atom 6 为拟与 Seed 碳成键的原子。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 探索 C–N3 键形成，既覆盖氮自由基又覆盖由 Si–F 形成驱动的极性叠氮转移；它不要求复用 Pd/有机硼循环。
risks: 叠氮试剂及有机叠氮产物具有分解和安全风险，需要小尺度热稳定性评估
可能仅生成 TMSF 和非选择性分解物
叠氮基可能与金属催化剂或羰基相关中间体发生旁路反应
historical_hypotheses.route: 以 atom 6 为固定连接端筛选自由基和极性活化模式，目标为 CF3 衍生碳上的 C(F)–N3 单氟烯烃。

summary.activation_hypothesis: P-Si cleavage or transfer can be driven by silicon-directed activation.
summary.rationale: Tests phosphorus transfer coupled to fluoride affinity, with precursor breakdown and endpoint control unresolved.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 需要断裂或转移 P–Si 键；可比较氟离子、温和亲电活化剂和无活化对照，但必须监控氟硅烷形成。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 同步定量 Me3SiF 与 C(F)–P 产物。若 Me3SiF 形成而无 C–P 键，说明仅发生氟捕获；若 C–P 形成与 Me3SiF 同步且无 Pd 条件也成立，则支持硅驱动的 P 转移/脱氟路径。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 三(三甲基硅基)膦
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: P(SiMe3)3；索引 0 的 P 是拟转移和成键中心，Si 主要提供亲氟驱动力。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 这是金属自由的 P 键转移前体，可把强 Si–F 形成与 C–P 构建耦合。它检验氟捕获是否能驱动 Seed 中间体在保留一个 F 时停止，属于高信息量但高反应性的边界假设。
risks: 高度水敏和空气敏感
可能只消耗氟形成硅氟化物而不成 C–P 键
可能发生多次 P–Si 断裂及复杂磷物种歧化
强氟亲和性可能推动完全脱氟
historical_hypotheses.route: 氟离子诱导 P–Si 裂解生成亲核性磷物种，同时 Me3SiF 捕获离去氟；磷对 CF3 来源碳成键并再消除一个氟，形成固定 C(F)–P 连接。

evidence_role_annotation.scope: Original candidate hypotheses retained; source-specific positive and limiting evidence do not establish target-system outcome.

summary.activation_hypothesis: Reductive cleavage and decarboxylation can release a methyl radical.
summary.rationale: Tests the smallest alkyl-radical donor without assuming organoboron transfer; hydrogen abstraction and carbonyl reduction compete.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 光氧化还原单电子还原并脱羧；需要能够还原该活化酯且不会快速还原 Seed 羰基的光催化体系。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 用同位素标记的甲基或定量气体分析确认脱羧，同时比较无光、无光催化剂及加入自由基捕获剂的结果；检测甲基化单氟烯烃与简单氢脱氟产物。
historical_hypotheses.family: N-羟基邻苯二甲酰亚胺氧化还原活性酯
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: N-羟基邻苯二甲酰亚胺乙酸酯
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 还原裂解和脱羧后形成的甲基自由基；乙酰基甲基 atom 0 为拟成键原子。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 以最小烷基自由基探测烷基 C–C 键形成，避免把 Seed 中有争议的烷基有机硼边界外推为所有烷基转移方式的失败。
risks: 活化酯可能水解或被碱直接分解
甲基自由基可能优先夺氢
还原条件可能引起羰基还原、脱羰或非选择性连续脱氟
historical_hypotheses.route: 独立产生甲基自由基并使其与 Seed 反应中心结合，再通过还原-消除或自由基链终止形成保留一个氟的烯烃；不要求 Pd 或原有机硼伙伴。

nodes.label: C006
nodes.name: Benzenediazonium tetrafluoroborate

summary.activation_hypothesis: Single-electron reduction and nitrogen extrusion can release a phenyl radical.
summary.rationale: Provides an aryl entry independent of boron transmetalation; radical capture and the retained-fluorine endpoint remain hypotheses.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 可见光/光氧化还原单电子还原以脱去 N2；光催化剂和还原剂需按实际 Seed 底物的还原窗口筛选。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 同步监测 N2 释放、芳基自由基捕获物、目标单氟烯烃和过度脱氟产物；加入低比例自由基钟或进行明暗交替实验，区分持续自由基链与单纯光催化过程。
historical_hypotheses.family: 芳基重氮盐自由基前体
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 苯重氮四氟硼酸盐
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 失去 N2 后形成的苯基自由基；提交 SMILES 中与重氮基相连的芳环碳 atom 2 是拟成键原子。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 提供不依赖原 Pd/有机硼转金属化循环的芳基自由基入口，用于检验 CF3 衍生中心能否经自由基加成或自由基-极性交叉形成目标 C–C 键并停在单氟烯烃。
risks: 重氮盐可能热分解或发生还原性脱重氮副反应
芳基自由基可能夺氢、二聚或加成到羰基氧而非目标碳
光催化剂或阴离子可能改变脱氟数目和产物 E/Z 比
historical_hypotheses.route: 在独立光化学条件中产生苯基自由基，测试其对 Seed 底物或经确认的 Seed 相关 gem-二氟烯酮的加成，随后考察单电子还原/氟离子消除能否给出固定的 C(F)–Ph 连通性。

nodes.label: C010
nodes.name: tert-Butyl iodide

summary.activation_hypothesis: Single-electron C-I cleavage can release a tert-butyl radical.
summary.rationale: Tests a crowded tertiary alkyl fragment without equating radical capture with organoboron transfer.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 可采用光氧化还原、低价金属或其他经验证的 C–I 单电子裂解方式；避免预设必须使用 Seed 的 Pd 催化剂。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 检测异丁烷、异丁烯、偶联二聚体及目标叔丁基化产物；比较自由基捕获剂、暗反应和不含活化剂的对照，以判断 C–I 均裂是否与产物形成相关。
historical_hypotheses.family: 叔烷基卤化物自由基前体
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 叔丁基碘
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: C–I 单电子裂解后形成的叔丁基自由基；中心叔碳 atom 1 为拟成键原子。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 作为高度取代烷基自由基和显著位阻边界探针，可区分自由基加成能力与原有机硼转金属化的位阻限制。
risks: 易发生还原脱卤或消除生成异丁烯
叔丁基自由基可能大量夺氢或二聚
位阻可能降低目标碳捕获速率并放大过度脱氟或底物分解
historical_hypotheses.route: 在独立单电子活化条件下生成叔丁基自由基，探测其是否能在 CF3 衍生碳建立 C–C 键并经后续氟离子损失达到单氟烯烃。

nodes.label: C013
nodes.name: (Bromomethyl)cyclopropane

summary.activation_hypothesis: Single-electron C-Br cleavage can generate a cyclopropylmethyl radical.
summary.rationale: Tests an alkyl-radical entry with ring opening as a possible competing diagnostic; no radical result is assumed.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 通过光氧化还原或低价金属实现 C–Br 单电子裂解；条件应允许时间分辨分析，以观察自由基重排。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 分别定量未重排的环丙甲基连接产物和开环高烯基产物；开环/未开环比及其对捕获剂浓度的依赖可作为自由基寿命的判别信号。
historical_hypotheses.family: 自由基钟型烷基卤化物
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 溴甲基环丙烷
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: C–Br 裂解产生的环丙甲基自由基；溴甲基碳 atom 1 是固定目标连通性下的拟成键原子。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 兼作小型烷基转移试剂和自由基钟。若形成目标键前存在寿命足够长的游离自由基，可能观察到竞争性环丙环开裂。
risks: 自由基快速开环会生成与预定未重排连通性不同的副产物
可能发生还原脱溴或亲核取代
环丙基结构可能在强酸、强 Lewis 酸或金属条件下发生非自由基开环
historical_hypotheses.route: 独立生成环丙甲基自由基，目标仍定义为 Seed CF3 衍生碳与 atom 1 成键；开环产物仅作为机制诊断副产物，不视为目标连通性成功。

nodes.label: C053
nodes.name: TEMPO

summary.activation_hypothesis: The supplied radical has a proposed oxygen-centred capture pathway.
summary.rationale: Tests O-radical trapping and connectivity; radical inhibition alone would not establish the target C-O bond.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_hypotheses.activation: TEMPO 本身是持久氮氧自由基；可直接加入或与光/热自由基生成体系配合，不需要额外生成 O 自由基。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 定量 TEMPO 加合物、羟胺化 TEMPO、底物转化和所有含氟产物；比较低转化率下的化学计量加合与单纯反应抑制，避免把抑制本身当作自由基证据。
historical_hypotheses.family: 持久氮氧自由基/氧转移边界探针
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 2,2,6,6-四甲基哌啶-1-氧自由基（TEMPO）
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 氧中心持久自由基；氧 atom 0 是拟与 Seed 碳成键的原子。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 既是 C–O 键形成的边界候选，也是捕获 CF3 衍生碳自由基的机制探针。只有分离或正交确认固定 C(F)–O–TEMPO 连通性才视为成键结果。
risks: 可能氧化或抑制催化剂而不形成目标加合物
TEMPO 加合物可能发生 β-裂解或继续脱氟
高浓度持久自由基可能改变链长和整体氟质量平衡
historical_hypotheses.route: 直接捕获反应过程中可能形成的 Seed 碳自由基；目标是 O atom 0 与 CF3 衍生碳成键并最终保留一个氟，而非仅观察反应被抑制。

nodes.name: Imidazole

summary.activation_hypothesis: Separate archived hypotheses target the neutral pyridine-like N and the N-H-derived nitrogen.
summary.rationale: Tests small heteroaromatic N capture while distinguishing proton transfer, competing N sites and catalyst binding.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_citations.quote: Nucleophilic addition of gem-difluoroalkenes (CF 2 unit on the vinylic position) followed by elimination of a fluoride anion provides a common approach to generate fluoroalkenes.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 以中性咪唑测试吡啶型 N 的直接孤对电子进攻；并行比较无碱和温和碱条件，以区分中性 N 进攻与去质子化后路径。无需预先形成金属咪唑盐。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 用 19F NMR 监测单氟烯烃形成，用 15N-HMBC（可行时）或完整的 1H/13C HMBC 确认新键连接 atom 1；比较 N1/N3 互变异构相关产物、盐型加合物和仅配位抑制。底物消耗但无 C-N 产物将把配位抑制与成键分开。
historical_hypotheses.family: 单环含氮杂芳族；咪唑型中性 N 亲核体
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 咪唑
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 中性咪唑的吡啶型氮 atom 1；另一 [nH] 氮不是本提案的成键原子，但其质子转移会影响实际反应形式。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 这是紧凑的杂芳 N 成键探针，用于探索带保留 F 的烯碳-N 连接。它也是强配位边界探针：可检验 C-N 成键、单纯催化剂抑制和酸碱活化之间的区别；没有将局部 gem-CF2 氨基去氟先例冒充当前 CF3/羰基体系的证据。
risks: 咪唑可能强烈配位并改变金属或 Lewis 酸物种
互变异构和质子转移会使有效亲核位点依赖条件
可能形成稳定盐或可逆加合物而非净失氟产物
强碱和高温可能促进过度脱氟或羰基副反应
historical_hypotheses.route: 探索 atom 1 的 N 与带保留 F 的 CF3 衍生烯碳形成 C-N 键，保持羰基骨架并达到净损失两个 F 的目标连接。

historical_hypotheses.activation: 优先比较中性咪唑与温和碱活化条件；不预设需要原Seed的Pd循环。可另用经鉴定的Seed相关gem-CF2烯酮进行直接截获，以区分前体生成与C-N成键。

citations.quote: Nucleophilic addition of gem-difluoroalkenes (CF 2 unit on the vinylic position) followed by elimination of a fluoride anion provides a common approach to generate fluoroalkenes.

historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 同时比较母体CF3底物和独立制备的相应gem-CF2中间体；用定量19F NMR/LC-MS寻找保留一个F且在原CF3碳形成C-N键的产物，并以无咪唑、无碱和产物再暴露实验判别截获、过度脱氟及分解。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 咪唑
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 中性咪唑或由N-H去质子化得到的咪唑负离子；成键位点为提交SMILES中的[nH]氮，而非吡啶型氮。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 供应的局部修正给出咪唑在另一种gem-CF2烯烃上形成同碳C(F)-N连接的实例，但该底物不是羰基共轭Seed中间体，因此这里只外推局部加成-消除能力。咪唑兼具中等亲核性和较低位阻，适合作为首要截获探针。
risks: 咪唑的另一氮可能强配位并改变Pd或其他路易斯酸的物种分布。
较强碱或较高温度可能增加过度脱氟、烯酮聚合或产物异构化。
观察到抑制不能单独证明咪唑未发生C-N成键。
historical_hypotheses.route: 假设先由CF3片段形成Seed相关gem-CF2烯酮，再由咪唑N加成并消除F-，得到在原CF3碳同时连接N和保留F的羰基共轭烯烃；也应探索不依赖原Pd体系的直接碱促取代。

nodes.name: Methanesulfonamide

summary.activation_hypothesis: Base activation can generate a delocalized nitrogen nucleophile.
summary.rationale: Tests the trade-off between acidity and attenuated N nucleophilicity; O coordination and catalyst inhibition may compete.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 需要碱生成甲磺酰胺负离子；碱身份和水含量应独立考察。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 通过15N NMR或晶体/二维NMR排除磺酰氧取代；与N,N-二甲基甲磺酰胺负对照比较，并进行目标产物再暴露以评估继续脱氟。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 甲磺酰胺
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 去质子化甲磺酰胺；二号N为成键原子，两个磺酰氧仅为电荷离域位点。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 甲磺酰胺负离子比普通胺更弱亲核且高度离域，是对电亲性和离去基能力的严格边界测试；若成功可给出较稳定的N-磺酰烯胺连接。
risks: 需要的碱性可能引发过度脱氟。
可能出现O-取代或仅形成紧密离子对。
磺酰胺盐的溶解度可能成为速率控制因素。
historical_hypotheses.route: 预形成或原位形成甲磺酰胺负离子，对Seed相关gem-CF2烯酮进行N加成和F-消除，保持羰基骨架。

nodes.label: C038
nodes.name: 4-(Trifluoromethyl)aniline

summary.activation_hypothesis: Neutral-amine capture is compared conceptually with controlled deprotonation.
summary.rationale: Tests whether reduced N nucleophilicity limits coupling, without adding a second coordinating heteroatom.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 先使用中性胺；若无截获，再与苯胺负离子条件分开比较，避免仅通过提高温度补偿低亲核性。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 与苯胺进行同一分析平台下的竞争或平行实验；若CF3取代只降低C-N产物而gem-CF2中间体积累，将支持N进攻电子需求，而非底物生成差异。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 4-(三氟甲基)苯胺
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 中性芳胺或其受控生成的苯胺负离子；零号N为成键位点，芳环CF3不参与成键。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 该分子是苯胺电子贫化边界探针，用于检验中性N亲核性降低是否可由去质子化补偿，同时避免增加额外配位杂原子。
risks: 中性形式可能过慢，导致误判为家族不相容。
强碱活化可能加速目标底物或产物过度脱氟。
低溶解度或盐的离子对可能影响比较。
historical_hypotheses.route: 比较中性芳胺加成-消除与预活化芳胺负离子取代两种路径，目标连接均为原CF3碳上的C(F)-N。

nodes.label: C039
nodes.name: Morpholine

summary.activation_hypothesis: Neutral amine capture and condition-dependent proton transfer are proposed.
summary.rationale: Tests an aliphatic N donor whose ring oxygen alters basicity and provides a competing coordination site.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_citations.quote: Based on these experiments and literature reports [28,33], we propose a base-mediated nucleophilic addition–elimination of morpholine to gem-difluoroalkene 1 affording INT-1, which can generate product 3 via two routes (Figure 5).
gem-Difluoroalkene 143 underwent a base-promoted 5-endo-trig intramolecular nucleophilic attack by N and subsequent β-fluoride elimination to generate a diverse array of 2-fluoroindoles 144.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 先测试中性吗啉；若反应不足，再比较非亲核碱辅助条件。无需先生成N-金属试剂。

citations.quote: Based on these experiments and literature reports [28,33], we propose a base-mediated nucleophilic addition–elimination of morpholine to gem-difluoroalkene 1 affording INT-1, which can generate product 3 via two routes (Figure 5).

historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 将吗啉与N-甲基吗啉平行比较：只有含N-H的吗啉产生C(F)-N产物将支持加成-消除/脱质子过程；同步监测可能的氨基炔、完全脱氟产物和吗啉加成物。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 吗啉
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 中性仲胺；五号N为成键原子，环内O仅为调电子和潜在配位位点。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 供应证据提出吗啉对另一gem-CF2烯烃的碱促加成-消除，虽后续产物路径不同，但支持把吗啉作为局部C-N截获探针。环氧使其碱性低于哌啶，可探查亲核性与催化剂配位之间的平衡。
risks: 吗啉及其氧原子可能竞争配位。
可能形成暂态加成物后转化为炔烃或其他完全脱氟物。
强碱可能使目标单氟烯烃继续失氟。
historical_hypotheses.route: 中性吗啉进攻Seed相关gem-CF2烯酮的末端含氟碳，随后质子转移和F-消除，形成同碳C(F)-N连接。

historical_hypotheses.activation: 吗啉可作为中性二级胺直接测试，也可在温和碱存在下形成更高比例的 N 亲核活性态；应单独评估无 Pd、Seed Pd 体系及不同弱碱条件。

citations.quote: gem-Difluoroalkene 143 underwent a base-promoted 5-endo-trig intramolecular nucleophilic attack by N and subsequent β-fluoride elimination to generate a diverse array of 2-fluoroindoles 144.

historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 用 19F NMR 检测新的单氟烯烃信号，并以 MS/MS 或分离后的 NMR 确认 C-N 键而非吗啉氧成键；加入 N-甲基吗啉作为无 N-H 对照，以区分脱质子路径和普通路易斯碱作用。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 吗啉
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 中性吗啉氮或其去质子化 N 态；目标成键原子为氮 atom 0。环内氧 atom 3 仅作为潜在竞争配位位点，不指定为目标成键原子。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 提供小型、非芳香 N-H 亲核体，同时用环氧暴露配位竞争这一边界。引证是分子内 N 进攻 gem-二氟烯并发生 β-F 消除的局部先例；本提案外推至分子间吗啉捕获和 Seed 羰基共轭中心，不转移其成环几何或催化循环。
risks: 氮和氧均可能强配位 Pd，造成催化剂抑制或物种切换
胺可能与羰基发生缩合、加成或促进底物分解
碱性增强可能同时增加完全脱氟
可能观察到 O 成键、N 成键或盐形成的混合结果
historical_hypotheses.route: 探索吗啉氮在 CF3 来源碳上形成 C-N 键并保留一个氟的分子间脱氟胺化；允许经离子型加成／消除路径，不要求 Seed 有机硼伙伴或其转金属化过程。

nodes.name: Pyrazole

summary.activation_hypothesis: Neutral and controlled N-H-deprotonation branches are proposed.
summary.rationale: Varies N-N adjacency, acidity and coordination relative to imidazole; N-site identity must remain explicit.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 比较中性吡唑和预先受控去质子化的吡唑；碱强度应与过度脱氟窗口分开筛选。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 用15N标记或二维NMR确认C-N连接发生在原[nH]氮；与N-甲基吡唑负对照及咪唑平行比较，以判别N-H活化需求和单纯配位抑制。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 吡唑
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 吡唑或吡唑负离子；指定成键原子为零号[nH]氮，邻位吡啶型氮仅视为潜在配位位点。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 吡唑较咪唑具有不同的N-N相邻电子结构和酸性，可覆盖去质子化容易但亲核性、配位性不同的边界。没有供应证据直接证明其适用于Seed连接。
risks: N-N唑可能形成强配位络合物并抑制金属介导的前体生成。
互变异构可能造成区域归属困难。
碱活化可能与烯酮过度脱氟同时发生。
historical_hypotheses.route: 以吡唑负离子对Seed相关gem-CF2烯酮进行加成-消除，形成C(F)-N吡唑基烯烃；母体CF3底物的一锅转化仅作为独立探索路线。

historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 使用15N标记或HMBC确认生成N-烯基化而非O-烯基化产物；同时加入N-甲基苯甲酰胺作为无N-H对照，并监测羰基交换或水解。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 苯甲酰胺
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 苯甲酰胺负离子；指定零号N成键，酰胺氧是潜在竞争O-成键位点但不作为本提案目标。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 酰胺负离子将面板扩展到共振稳定、潜在N/O两可的亲核体，可检验目标烯基碳是否支持较弱N亲核体的直接取代。

酰胺可能与金属形成惰性配合物。
historical_hypotheses.route: 由苯甲酰胺负离子在经验证的gem-CF2烯酮上进行N选择性加成-消除，形成烯基酰胺C(F)-N连接；不调用有机硼转金属步骤。

historical_hypotheses.activation: 氨可作为中性亲核体测试，也可通过铵盐/碱对原位控制游离氨；不建议默认使用极强碱。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 采用15NH3确认C-N来源，并定量一级氨基单取代、二次烯基化、亚胺化和完全脱氟产物；游离氨与铵盐/碱对照可判别有效活性形式。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 氨
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 中性NH3，零号N为成键原子。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 氨是位阻最小的N亲核体，可检验目标碳是否能够形成直接C(F)-NH2连接，并提供与伯胺中烷基电子效应和羰基缩合倾向不同的边界。
risks: 初生一级胺产物可能比氨更亲核并发生二次取代。
氨或铵盐可能改变酸碱平衡、盐溶解度和氟离子活度。
可能形成羰基亚胺或导致难以闭合的氮/氟质量平衡。
historical_hypotheses.route: 氨对经验证的Seed相关gem-CF2烯酮直接加成并消除F-，目标为原CF3碳上的C(F)-NH2；同时以母体CF3底物检验是否存在不依赖Pd的一锅两次脱氟路线。

historical_hypotheses.activation: 中性三甲胺可直接作为孤对电子供体；无需去质子化。应在能够观察短寿命加成物的条件下评估。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 低转化时程中搜索烯基三甲基铵盐，并用外加亲核体或离子交换测试其可逆性；与空间更大、非亲核叔胺对照可区分亲核加成和单纯碱/配位作用。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 三甲胺
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 中性叔胺，一号N以孤对电子形成第四个C-N键，预期初级产物为季铵型物种。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 叔胺不能通过N-H去质子化，因而是区分直接孤对进攻与N-H辅助加成-消除的边界探针。预期产物电荷状态与其他候选不同，可能是可分离产物，也可能只是离去基或催化中间体。
risks: 季铵加成物可能可逆或继续消除，不能仅凭底物消耗判断。
三甲胺可作为碱促进非选择性脱氟。
挥发性和盐形成会使有效浓度难以保持。
historical_hypotheses.route: 三甲胺直接进攻gem-CF2烯酮的目标碳并伴随F-离去，形成保留一个F的烯基三甲基铵连接；这是探索性终点，不假定其为中性稳定产物。

nodes.label: C047
nodes.name: Cyanamide

summary.activation_hypothesis: Neutral or deprotonated amino-N capture is proposed.
summary.rationale: Tests a compact nitrile-conjugated N donor while distinguishing its amino and nitrile nitrogens.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 可先测试中性氨基氰；其N-H酸性允许在温和至中等碱下形成氨基氰负离子。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 用13C/15N标记和HMBC确认成键原子为氨基N而非腈N；比较中性与去质子化条件，并搜索碳二亚胺化、聚合和完全脱氟产物。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 氨基氰
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 中性氨基氰或由二号氨基N去质子化形成的阴离子；零号腈N不作为本提案成键中心。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 氨基氰体积小、电子贫化且具有明确的非成键腈氮，可测试小型离域N亲核体，并满足对分子内不同氮角色的区分。
risks: 可能发生聚合或转化为碳二亚胺相关物。
两个氮造成光谱归属和金属配位复杂性。
碱活化可能与目标烯烃的进一步脱氟竞争。
historical_hypotheses.route: 氨基N对Seed相关gem-CF2烯酮加成并消除F-，形成C(F)-NH-CN连接；不假定原Seed催化剂可兼容。

nodes.name: Aniline

summary.activation_hypothesis: Neutral-amine capture and controlled deprotonation are alternative proposed states.
summary.rationale: Provides the parent arylamine for electronic comparison; condensation and additional substitution can compete.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_citations.quote: For instance, the reaction of aniline with trifluoromethylstyrene or with vinylnaphthalene catalyzed by [Pd(OSO2CF3)2{(R)- binap}] at 258C formed the addition products in quantitative yields,andwith81%and64%enantioselectivity,respectively (Scheme 38).
nitrogen-based nucleophiles: amines, anilines, Ph2C=NH, n-BuLi (2 3 equiv) THF/toluene = 1:1, rt, 28 98%

historical_hypotheses.activation: 可直接测试中性苯胺，并与较温和的非亲核碱组合；若需要，可比较预形成苯胺负离子作为单独候选。

citations.quote: For instance, the reaction of aniline with trifluoromethylstyrene or with vinylnaphthalene catalyzed by [Pd(OSO2CF3)2{(R)- binap}] at 258C formed the addition products in quantitative yields,andwith81%and64%enantioselectivity,respectively (Scheme 38).
nitrogen-based nucleophiles: amines, anilines, Ph2C=NH, n-BuLi (2 3 equiv) THF/toluene = 1:1, rt, 28 98%

historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 与正丁胺和对三氟甲基苯胺作电子梯度比较；定量母体、gem-CF2中间体、目标C(F)-N产物和完全脱氟产物，以确定电子效应落在前体形成还是N进攻步骤。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 苯胺
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 中性苯胺，零号氨基N为成键原子。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 苯胺提供较低碱性、共振削弱的N亲核体，并有其他含氟烯烃加成和gem-二氟脱氟体系的局部类比；这些证据均不固定Seed羰基连接，也不证明净失两个F。
risks: 苯胺可能配位或参与羰基缩合。
较低亲核性可能使gem-CF2中间体先分解或聚合。
Pd存在时可能切换为与目标无关的烯烃加成路径。
historical_hypotheses.route: 苯胺直接截获Seed相关gem-CF2烯酮并经F-消除形成烯基C-N键；同时测试无Pd路线以避免把原Seed循环设为前提。

nodes.label: C049
nodes.name: 1,2,4-Triazole

summary.activation_hypothesis: Controlled N-H deprotonation can supply a triazolide.
summary.rationale: Tests the distinction between easy anion formation, useful nucleophilicity and strong coordination.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 通常需要碱促进N-H去质子化；应使用碱身份矩阵，而不是默认沿用Seed的KHCO3或Pd。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 比较1,2,4-三唑、中性N-甲基三唑对照及预形成三唑盐；通过19F NMR与LC-HRMS判断是目标C(F)-N产物、过度脱氟还是仅底物回收。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 1,2,4-三唑
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 由零号[nH]氮去质子化形成的三唑负离子；其余两个氮为竞争配位位点。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 高氮含量降低单个N位点的亲核性但增强酸性和配位能力，是区分“易生成阴离子”与“阴离子足够亲核”的边界探针。
risks: 多齿配位可能显著改变催化剂物种。
可能得到区域异构N-烯基化产物。
盐析、溶解度和离子对效应可能掩盖本征反应性。
historical_hypotheses.route: 三唑负离子截获经独立验证的gem-CF2烯酮，随后失去F-并保持羰基共轭骨架；不要求原有机硼转金属步骤。

historical_hypotheses.reason: 正丁胺代表无额外杂原子的强亲核伯胺。引证仅证明其能在另一多氟羰基芳环上发生氨基脱氟，电亲性和连接位置均不同，因此属于局部反应类别外推。
risks: 伯胺可与羰基形成亚胺或烯胺，破坏固定羰基骨架。

挥发性和盐形成会改变实际游离胺浓度。

historical_hypotheses.family: 单环含氧芳香族；中性酚型孤对电子供体
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 苯酚
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 中性苯酚的氧孤对电子为提交的成键形式；可能存在条件依赖的原位去质子化，但不把预制苯氧盐作为所购试剂。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 最小型 O/C 双位点芳香探针。本提案专门考察氧原子与保留 F 的 CF3 衍生烯碳成键；所引文献只提供不同氟代烯体系中酚亲核体的局部类比，不证明当前羰基底物或两次失氟过程可行。
risks: 酸碱状态和含水量可能改变 O/C 选择性

目标烯醚可能发生水解、异构化或后续加成
historical_hypotheses.route: 保持 Seed 羰基骨架，探索中性 O 进攻或加成-消除，使苯氧基最终连接到带保留 F 的 CF3 衍生烯碳，并实现净损失两个 F。

historical_hypotheses.activation: 比较中性苯酚与碱原位生成的苯氧负离子；需要筛查碱强度、含水量及是否必须保留 Seed 的 Pd 体系。苯酚本身也可作为较弱的中性 O 亲核体边界探针。

historical_hypotheses.name: 苯酚
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 中性苯酚或由其原位形成的苯氧负离子；候选成键原子是氧 atom 0。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 提供最简单的芳氧基转移探针，并可与预制苯氧化钠构成明确的中性／离子前体对。所引证事实涉及不同的三氟甲基卡宾插入体系，仅支持醇氧形成含氟烯基醚的局部类比，不证明本 Seed 羰基底物或 Pd 条件兼容。

生成的烯基醚可能水解、异构化或继续脱氟
historical_hypotheses.route: 保持 Seed 羰基骨架与 CF3 来源反应中心不变，探索在该碳上形成 C-O 键并保留一个烯基氟；分别考察无 Pd 的亲核取代路径及完整 Seed 催化混合物中的捕获路径。

historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 使用H2-18O平行实验，并以LC-MS/HRMS及19F NMR确认18O是否进入CF3来源且保留一个F的烯碳；同时比较水解、羰基水合和完全脱氟产物。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 水
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 中性H2O；成键原子为唯一的氧原子。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 覆盖最小、最不位阻的中性氧供体，并检验目标中心是否能在不预制强烷氧负离子的情况下形成C-O键。这是边界假设，不由Seed结果证明。

summary.rationale: Tests a defined ionic N precursor relative to neutral N-H donors; ion pairing and O competition remain possible.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 以预形成的邻苯二甲酰亚胺钾直接提供N阴离子；不再依赖反应体系原位去质子化。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 与中性邻苯二甲酰亚胺平行比较，并改变阳离子络合环境；若只有钾盐反应且形成经NMR确认的N-烯基酰亚胺，可支持阴离子截获而非中性加成。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 邻苯二甲酰亚胺钾
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 离散的酰亚胺N阴离子钾盐；三号[N-]为成键原子，羰基氧不作为目标成键位点。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 该试剂是具体、稳定的预形成N阴离子，覆盖无需体系内强碱生成亲核体的路线，并可通过后续脱保护潜在转化为一级氨基连接。
risks: 钾盐可能在非极性介质中溶解度不足。
离子对或聚集状态可能控制反应性。
可能发生O-烯基化、羰基交换或单氟产物继续消除。
historical_hypotheses.route: 酰亚胺N阴离子直接取代gem-CF2烯酮上的一个F，经加成-消除得到同碳C(F)-N邻苯二甲酰亚胺产物。

historical_hypotheses.activation: 苯胺锂已是预活化N阴离子；需要严格控制质子源和离子对，不再额外加入强碱作为默认条件。

citations.quote: nitrogen-based nucleophiles: amines, anilines, Ph2C=NH, n-BuLi (2 3 equiv) THF/toluene = 1:1, rt, 28 98%

historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 与中性苯胺在相同有效苯胺基浓度下比较，并使用氘代淬灭测定未反应苯胺负离子；若苯胺锂快速消耗gem-CF2中间体但不给C-N产物，应重点检查羰基加成和过度脱氟。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 苯胺锂
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 预形成的苯胺N-锂盐；一号[NH-]为C-N成键原子，锂仅为反离子/配位中心。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 这是苯胺的明确金属化亲核形式，用于区分中性芳胺亲核性不足与体系不支持C-N取代。引证涉及强碱活化的其他脱氟体系，只提供局部类比。
risks: 强碱和高亲核性可能直接进攻Seed羰基。
对水和质子杂质高度敏感，实际活性浓度易漂移。
锂离子配位可能改变烯酮构象、聚集或脱氟选择性。
historical_hypotheses.route: 苯胺N-锂试剂直接向经鉴定的Seed相关gem-CF2烯酮转移N亲核体，随后F-消除；这是独立的阴离子路线，不要求Pd或有机硼循环。

historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 同时测定C(F)-OSiMe3候选产物、Me3SiF和游离氟；与等碱性烷氧盐及单纯氟捕获添加剂比较，以区分真正的硅氧基转移与仅由氟清除促进的脱氟。

historical_hypotheses.reason: 覆盖具有强Si-F形成驱动力的特殊O-供体，可能通过亲核加成后氟捕获改变局部能量学。这是机制边界假设，没有供应证据证明其能给出目标产物。

historical_hypotheses.route: 优先采用可信偕二氟烯酮的无Pd分步试验；若观察到目标硅氧基化，再评价原三氟底物的一锅路径。

historical_hypotheses.reason: 以较低碱性和较低亲核性的含氟烷氧负离子扩展电子范围，并提供可由19F NMR独立追踪的供体。引证来自磺酰基活化二氟丙烯体系，只能支持类别级局部类比。

citations.quote: Vinyl substitution products 3–9 were prepared by the stoi- chiometric addition of substituted sodium phenoxides to aryl TFVEs 1-bromo-4-(triﬂuorovinyloxy)benzene (1) and 1-methoxy- 4-(triﬂuorovinyloxy)benzene (2) in anhydrous DMF at 60 ◦Cf o r 1 h (Table 1).

historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 用LC-MS和19F NMR寻找C(F)-OPh产物，并与甲醇钠比较；检测芳基C键形成、羰基加成及完全脱氟，以排除把非目标产物误作乙烯基O取代。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 苯酚钠
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 苯氧负离子；索引0为唯一氧并为候选成键原子，索引7为钠。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 将脂肪烷氧负离子扩展到共振稳定的芳氧负离子。引证为芳基三氟乙烯醚上的直接乙烯基取代，目标电亲片段及同碳保留F关系与本研究不完全相同。
risks: 酚氧负离子可能配位或抑制Pd
亲核性低于简单烷氧负离子
产物芳基乙烯醚可能发生E/Z异构化
较强碱或长时间可能导致进一步脱氟
historical_hypotheses.route: 以无需Pd的可信偕二氟烯酮直接取代作为主要路线，并以Seed一锅体系评价条件兼容性；不要求有机硼伙伴。

historical_hypotheses.activation: 作为预制离子态直接引入；应控制水和质子源，并与等摩尔苯酚加相同钠盐或碱的对照比较，以分离亲核体状态效应和盐效应。

citations.quote: insertion reaction with amines or alcohols, delivering gem -difluoroenamines 4–3 and difluorovinyl ethers 4–4 in moderate to good yields.

historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 以苯酚／苯氧化钠配对时间过程监测起始物、C(F)-O 产物和完全脱氟产物；另加不含苯氧负离子的匹配钠盐对照，判断结果是否来自 O 亲核性而非离子强度或 Pd 盐析。
historical_hypotheses.family: 阴离子 O 亲核体／酚盐
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 苯氧化钠
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 游离或离子对形式的苯氧负离子；成键原子为氧 atom 1，atom 0 是钠反离子而不是成键中心。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 与苯酚构成可解释的前体／状态对，可检验 C-O 成键是否要求预先存在的阴离子。引证只提供其他催化体系中醇氧形成二氟乙烯基醚的类比；这里外推到 Seed 固定羰基骨架和目标同碳 C(F)-O 连接。
risks: 在 DCE 中溶解度或离子聚集状态不确定
强亲核或强碱条件可能引起直接羰基反应
钠盐可能沉淀、置换 Pd 配体或加速过度脱氟
痕量水会改变有效苯氧负离子浓度
historical_hypotheses.route: 测试预形成 O 阴离子对假设的 gem-二氟烯酮型中间体或其他 Seed 派生亲电态的直接捕获；不要求沿用原有有机硼转金属化步骤。

historical_hypotheses.activation: 以预制烯丙醇钠测试，并与中性烯丙醇严格配对；应避免用可能直接参与烯丙基化或还原的活化剂。

citations.quote: The oxyanions attacked the b-carbon in diﬂuorobutenolides 1 or 2 with complete regio- selectivity to give products ( 4–10) of vinylic displacement of ﬂuorine (Scheme 1).

historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 比较烯丙醇钠、烯丙醇和甲醇钠；用二维NMR确认C(F)-OCH2CH=CH2连接，并搜索由烯丙基末端碳成键、双键迁移或完全脱氟产生的异构体。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 烯丙醇钠
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 烯丙氧负离子；索引3为成键氧，索引0为烯丙基末端碳但不是本提案的成键原子。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 比中性烯丙醇更直接地测试O-进攻，同时保留可诊断的π配位和C/O选择性竞争。引证的区域选择性属于二氟丁烯内酯，不能直接转移到Seed中心。
risks: 强碱性可能推动过度脱氟
烯丙基双键可能捕获金属或发生异构化
可能形成C成键副产物
钠盐聚集和溶解度可能掩盖内在反应性
historical_hypotheses.route: 对可信偕二氟烯酮进行直接O-加成/氟消除，并独立评价在原Seed Pd混合物中的兼容性。

historical_hypotheses.activation: 硫氰酸钾已提供阴离子；需要通过溶剂和反离子调节暴露，并设置异硫氰酸酯/氰化物分析以识别重排或裂解。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 用 19F NMR 与 IR/LC-MS 确认目标为 C(F)-SCN 而非 C(F)-NCS，并进行 13C 标记或 MS/MS 连接性验证。若仅得到 N 连接异构体，则明确否定 atom 1 的 S 成键提案。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 硫氰酸钾
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: atom 1 的硫氰酸根硫端进攻；atom 3 的氮是竞争端，但本提案只评价 S 成键。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 小型、线性、双端负离子边界探针；S 端成键可给可继续转化的氟代烯基硫氰酸酯，并强烈检验位点选择性。
risks: 可能发生 N 端成键形成异硫氰酸酯连接
盐在低极性溶剂中溶解度有限
可能配位或改变金属物种
产物可能水解、重排或继续脱氟
historical_hypotheses.route: 探索对固定 gem-二氟烯酮或完整底物的 S 端亲核取代，在原 CF3 碳形成 C-SCN 并保留一个 F。

summary.activation_hypothesis: The represented copper thiolate supplies a metal-associated sulfur donor.
summary.rationale: Tests the combined roles of sulfur transfer, metal identity and aggregation rather than assuming a free thiolate.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 该盐提供金属结合的甲硫负离子；可测试直接转硫、与独立 gem-二氟烯酮反应及与 Pd 共存三种模式。必须确认铜盐真实溶解/聚集状态，不能由 SMILES 推断溶液结构。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 比较甲硫醇盐、铜(I)甲硫醇盐和二甲二硫化物；监测铜沉淀、硫交换及 C(F)-SMe。若只有铜盐有效且速率依赖铜而不依赖 Pd，支持金属转移路径；若都等效，则更符合自由硫负离子路径。
historical_hypotheses.family: 铜结合硫醇盐转移前体
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 甲硫醇铜(I)
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: atom 1 的甲硫基硫为转移原子；atom 2 的 Cu(I) 是载体，不是成键中心。提交式表示 1:1 组成，不声称其固态或溶液核数。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 具体的金属-硫转移前体，可探索直接 C-S 转移并绕开游离硫醇对 Pd 的质子和毒化效应；其聚集体身份与条件兼容性均属未知。
risks: 铜硫醇盐可能是聚合或难溶物种
可能与 Pd 发生金属交换并形成失活硫化物
空气氧化可生成二硫化物
可能只促进底物脱氟而不转移甲硫基
historical_hypotheses.route: 探索铜辅助甲硫基转移到 CF3 衍生烯碳，并以氟离子离去形成 C(F)-SMe；不要求原有机硼转金属步骤。

summary.activation_hypothesis: The anionic sulfur terminus is the proposed transfer site.
summary.rationale: Tests a resonance-stabilized sulfur donor with possible radical transfer, fragmentation and competing sites.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 黄原酸盐已经具有亲核末端硫；可比较暗反应、热反应和单电子激活条件，以区分离子型取代与黄原酸基自由基加成。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 确认新键连接到末端 atom 1，而不是硫代羰基 atom 3；使用 13C 标记黄原酸羰基、MS/MS 和产物衍生验证。自由基抑制剂只作为差异性对照，不单独作为机制证明。
historical_hypotheses.family: 黄原酸盐末端硫亲核体
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 乙基黄原酸钾（末端硫成键提案）
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: atom 1 的阴离子末端硫成键；atom 3 是独立评价的硫代羰基硫。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 兼具稳定硫阴离子和潜在自由基转移能力，可覆盖离子型与单电子型 C-S 构建，同时保留可进一步裂解的黄原酸基。
risks: 两个硫位点可能造成连接异构或硫交换
可能发生自由基链转移和非选择性加成
盐的溶解度及反离子效应显著
黄原酸基或目标氟代烯烃可能热分解
historical_hypotheses.route: 使末端硫在原 CF3 碳成键，随后失氟得到 C(F)-S-C(=S)OEt；不要求有机硼或 Seed 转金属步骤。

historical_hypotheses.activation: 本提案针对黄原酸盐的硫代羰基硫；可能需要光氧化、金属配位或其他单电子激活才能使该位点参与，不能假定其与末端硫等效。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 与同一分子 atom 1 成键提案并行；通过同位素标记、二维 NMR 和选择性水解区分两种连接异构体。未观察到 atom 3 连接而 atom 1 连接明显，将界定黄原酸盐的位点边界。
historical_hypotheses.family: 黄原酸盐硫代羰基硫边界探针
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 乙基黄原酸钾（硫代羰基硫成键提案）
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: atom 3 的中性硫代羰基硫是候选成键原子；阴离子 atom 1 为主要竞争位点。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 同一具体分子中的第二个化学不等价硫位点，用于检验活化后是否发生硫位点反转、重排或硫原子转移；这是高不确定性的边界假说。
risks: 更可能由 atom 1 成键而使本提案失败
活化可能导致 C-S 键裂解或硫交换
单电子条件可能破坏固定羰基骨架
产物连接性分析较困难
historical_hypotheses.route: 探索活化的硫代羰基硫向 CF3 衍生碳转移并伴随失氟；必须以原子连接性证据判定，而不能仅凭总分子式。

summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 硫代乙酸钾已经是硫负离子，可直接用于亲核取代；需要严格比较无 Pd、Seed Pd 和独立 gem-二氟烯酮条件。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 定量并确认 C(F)-SAc，而不是 O-乙酰化、C(F)-OAc 或水解后的 C(F)-SH；可用选择性脱乙酰和二维 NMR验证。与乙酸钾对照可判别 S/O 化学选择性。

historical_hypotheses.name: 硫代乙酸钾
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: atom 4 的阴离子硫形成新键；atom 3 的羰基氧是潜在竞争配位位点，但不是拟议成键原子。

historical_hypotheses.route: 使硫代乙酸根在原 CF3 碳通过加成-氟消除形成 C(F)-SAc，保持羰基骨架；后续脱保护不作为初筛成功判据。

historical_hypotheses.activation: 作为预制硫负离子使用，不需要先断 S-H；需筛查离子对、溶剂极性及冠醚等离子解离变量，但不预设其有利方向。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 在匹配水含量下比较苯硫酚/碱与苯硫酚钠；监测苯硫酚盐持久性、氟离子释放和 C(F)-SPh 形成。无 Pd 条件下的成键将直接支持阴离子取代假说。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 苯硫酚钠
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: atom 1 的苯硫负离子；钠仅为反离子。

historical_hypotheses.route: 优先测试对 gem-二氟烯酮的直接亲核加成-氟消除，再与完整 CF3 底物比较，以判断首个 C-F 活化是否仍需其他体系。

summary.activation_hypothesis: The supplied ion pair permits a direct P-centred nucleophilic branch.
summary.rationale: Bypasses uncertain in situ P-H activation while exposing strong-base, ion-pairing and carbonyl-compatibility boundaries.
summary.evidence_scope: Candidate-generation hypotheses and source-local analogies; compatibility with the target sequence is not an experimentally confirmed property.
summary.timing_note: English summaries prepared for this SI from archived candidate records; they do not establish a new historical selection rule.

historical_hypotheses.activation: 作为预成形磷负离子使用，不依赖 Seed 的 Pd/有机硼体系；比较直接加入与低温预混亲电底物后升温两种时序。
historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 快速淬灭时间序列并用低温 31P/19F NMR 搜索 P-加成的二氟阴离子中间体；比较质子化回收、单氟 C–P 产物及完全脱氟物。加入等量 Li 盐但使用中性二苯基膦的对照可分辨阳离子/离子强度效应。
historical_hypotheses.identity_status: SMILES validated; name association requires review
historical_hypotheses.name: 二苯基磷化锂
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 离子对 [Li+][PPh2−]；SMILES 中 Li 为索引 0，实际形成新键的是索引 1 的 P。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 预成形 P 阴离子可直接测试 gem-二氟烯酮加成/脱氟假设，完全绕开未知 Pd 转金属步骤。它是高反应性边界探针，重点在判断 C–P 成键是否可由单纯亲核加成实现。
risks: 强碱性可能引发羰基加成、烯醇化或底物分解
对水和氧极敏感
锂离子配位可能改变区域选择性
快速连续脱氟可能越过目标单氟停止点
historical_hypotheses.route: PPh2− 对暂态或独立生成的 gem-二氟烯酮之 CF2 碳直接加成，所得 β-氟碳负离子消除 LiF，形成目标 C(F)–PPh2 烯烃。

historical_hypotheses.name: 4-溴苯硫酚

historical_hypotheses.reason: 在芳基硫醇基准上加入吸电子且可追踪的对位溴，测试硫亲核性降低、Pd 氧化加成竞争及产物后续衍生可能性。引用仅是局部 C-F 被亲核体取代和硫醇/Pd 风险的类比。
risks: 芳基溴可能与 Pd 发生竞争性氧化加成
硫醇可能毒化 Pd
氧化成二硫化物
更低的硫亲核性可能导致底物仅脱氟或分解
historical_hypotheses.route: 探索固定 CF3 衍生碳上的脱氟 C-S 键形成，优先用原位硫负离子和无 Pd 条件判断是否存在直接 vinylic SNV 型路径。

historical_hypotheses.diagnostic: 用 19F NMR、GC-MS 和含硫选择性检测确认 C(F)-SEt；与苯硫酚及等酸度非硫质子源比较。若乙硫醇只改变脱氟数而不引入乙硫基，说明主要作用可能是质子转移。

historical_hypotheses.name: 乙硫醇
historical_hypotheses.reactive_form: 中性乙硫醇或乙硫负离子；atom 2 的硫形成新键。
historical_hypotheses.reason: 最简单的一级烷基硫边界之一，可将烷基硫亲核性、β-H 存在和芳基硫效应分开。该分子并非已知 Seed 成功试剂。
risks: 高挥发性导致实际暴露量漂移
游离硫醇与 Pd 强配位
可能作为质子源形成氢脱氟产物
乙硫基产物可能继续氧化或异构化
historical_hypotheses.route: 测试亲核加成-氟消除或金属辅助硫醇化，使 SEt 接到原 CF3 碳并停留在单氟烯烃。
